description: This file defines utility string functions within the Utils::String namespace, including case-insensitive comparisons, trimming, encoding, and system mode file management.

classes.name: loc_equal
classes.description: A template struct for locale-aware character comparison, used for case-insensitive string operations.

methods.name: find_substr_ci
methods.description: Finds a substring within a string in a case-insensitive manner, returning the position or -1 if not found.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring in a case-insensitive way.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the start of a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the end of a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: stringContains
methods.description: Checks if one string contains another in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiters.

methods.name: imageEncoder
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: updateSystemModeFile
methods.description: Updates the system mode configuration file with specified actions.

methods.name: getSystemModePropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property from the system mode configuration file.
